regional-governor.ts:
Ensure the named card cannot be played by any opponent of Regional Governor's player (all 2-3 of them).
Ensure an eliminated player is not affected (they are no longer a player).
Ensure that if another player takes control of Regional Governor, the restriction still applies to the original player's opponents (effect is not changed).
regional-governor.a2:
Ensure the named card cannot be played by either enemy player.
Ensure the named card can be played by the friendly teammate.

relentless#konstantines-folly.ts:
Ensure the first event played by each opponent each round loses all abilities, tracked separately per opponent (opponent B's first event is affected even if opponent A already played one).
Ensure an opponent's second and later events that round are unaffected, and that the tracking resets next round.
relentless#konstantines-folly.a2:
Ensure the first event played by each enemy player each round loses all abilities, tracked separately per enemy.
Ensure the friendly teammate's events are never affected.

admiral-ozzel#overconfident.ts:
Ensure every opponent may ready one unit of their own, each choosing independently, before the played Imperial unit's When Played abilities resolve.
Ensure eliminated players are not offered the choice.
admiral-ozzel#overconfident.a2:
Ensure both enemy players may ready a unit.
Ensure the friendly teammate is not offered the choice (not an opponent) and the played Imperial unit comes from your own hand only.

k2so#cassians-counterpart.ts:
Ensure that on defeat, the choice (3 damage to that player's base or discard a card) is made separately for each opponent, and each opponent's own base or hand is affected.
Ensure that when Overwhelm triggers on an attack in a 3-4 player game, the excess damage goes to the base of the defending player (the controller of the attacked unit).
k2so#cassians-counterpart.a2:
Ensure the When Defeated choice is made separately for each of the two enemy players, and the teammate is not affected.
Ensure Overwhelm excess damage goes to the base of whichever enemy controls the attacked unit.

saw-gerrera#extremist.ts:
Ensure every opponent must deal 2 damage to their own base as an additional cost to play an event, not just one.
Ensure that if the cost brings an opponent's base to 0, that opponent is eliminated and the event's ability does not resolve.
saw-gerrera#extremist.a2:
Ensure both enemy players must pay the 2 damage to their own base to play an event; the friendly teammate does not.
Ensure an enemy whose base is already at or past its health can still pay the 2 damage and play the event.

q.t: If the 2 damage cost puts an enemy base at or beyond its health, does the event's ability still not resolve (as the clarification says for a defeated base), or does it resolve normally because the player is not eliminated?

forced-surrender.ts:
Ensure only opponents whose base you damaged this phase discard 2 cards; opponents you did not damage are unaffected.
Ensure the draw 2 happens regardless of whether any opponent qualifies.
forced-surrender.a2:
Ensure only enemy players whose base you damaged this phase discard 2 cards.
Ensure damage dealt to the friendly teammate's base, or damage dealt by the teammate, does not count and the teammate never discards.

lothal-insurgent.ts:
Ensure that if you played another card this phase, each opponent (all of them) draws a card and then discards a random card from their hand.
Ensure the condition checks only cards played by you, not by other players.
lothal-insurgent.a2:
Ensure both enemy players draw then discard a random card when you played another card this phase.
Ensure a card played by the friendly teammate this phase does not satisfy the condition, and the teammate is not affected.

cripple-authority.ts:
Ensure each opponent is compared to you separately: only opponents who control more resources than you discard a card.
Ensure eliminated players are not compared.
cripple-authority.a2:
Ensure each enemy player is compared separately against your own resource count.
Ensure the teammate's resources are never counted and the teammate never discards.

qira#playing-her-part.ts:
Ensure you choose one opponent and only that opponent's hand is looked at.
Ensure the named card costs 3 more for every opponent to play, not just the chosen one.
Ensure the effect stays with the original player's opponents if control of Qi'ra changes.
qira#playing-her-part.a2:
Ensure you choose one of the two enemy players to look at; the teammate cannot be chosen and does not see the hand unless you tell them.
Ensure the named card costs 3 more for both enemy players but not for the friendly teammate.

no-bargain.ts:
Ensure each opponent discards a card from their own hand, and that you draw only one card total.
Ensure eliminated players are not affected.
no-bargain.a2:
Ensure both enemy players discard a card and you draw one card.
Ensure the friendly teammate does not discard.

the-clone-wars.ts:
Ensure you create Clone Troopers equal to the resources paid (not counting the event's cost), and each opponent creates that many Battle Droids.
Ensure each opponent receives the full number, not a share.
the-clone-wars.a2:
Ensure you create the Clone Troopers and both enemy players each create that many Battle Droids.
Ensure the friendly teammate creates no tokens.

senatorial-corvette.ts:
Ensure that when defeated, each opponent discards a card from their hand.
Ensure Saboteur ignores Sentinel for the chosen defender's controller, and that the attack is made against a single chosen opponent.
senatorial-corvette.a2:
Ensure that when defeated, both enemy players discard a card and the friendly teammate does not.
Ensure Saboteur ignores enemy Sentinels when attacking.

ziro-the-hutt#colorful-schemer.ts:
Ensure When Played gives a separate optional choice for each opponent to exhaust a unit that player controls, and declining for one does not affect the others.
Ensure On Attack likewise gives a separate optional choice per opponent to exhaust one of that player's resources.
ziro-the-hutt#colorful-schemer.a2:
Ensure both abilities give a separate optional choice for each of the two enemy players.
Ensure the friendly teammate's units and resources cannot be targeted.

devastator#hunting-the-rebellion.ts:
Ensure When Played deals 4 indirect damage to each opponent, with the Devastator controller assigning each opponent's damage among that opponent's units and base, all simultaneously.
Ensure a base brought to 0 eliminates that player.
Ensure other indirect damage you deal is also assigned by you to opponents only.
devastator#hunting-the-rebellion.a2:
Ensure 4 indirect damage is dealt to each enemy player, assigned by you among that enemy's units and base.
Ensure the friendly teammate's units and base cannot receive the damage.
Ensure indirect damage can still be assigned to an enemy base that is already at or past its health.

hunting-aggressor.ts:
Ensure indirect damage you deal to each opponent is increased by 1, per opponent receiving it (e.g. dealt to two opponents, each gets +1).
Ensure eliminated players receive no indirect damage and no bonus.
hunting-aggressor.a2:
Ensure indirect damage you deal to either enemy player is increased by 1.
Ensure indirect damage you deal to your teammate (if a card allows targeting them) is not increased, since a teammate is not an opponent.
Ensure indirect damage dealt by a teammate's card is not increased, since "you" is personal.

jedi-in-hiding.ts:
Ensure that when defeated and you use the Force, every opponent (not just one) discards a card from their hand; eliminated players do not.
Ensure Hidden behaves as in 1v1: it can't be attacked by any opponent the phase it was played, and can be attacked if it also has Sentinel.
jedi-in-hiding.a2:
Ensure that when defeated and you use the Force, both enemy players discard a card, and the teammate does not.
Ensure Hidden prevents attacks from both enemies; it behaves as in 1v1 otherwise.

admiral-ozzel#as-clumsy-as-he-is-stupid.ts:
Ensure that when defeated, each opponent discards a card from their hand (all 2-3 of them, each choosing their own card).
Ensure eliminated players do not discard.
admiral-ozzel#as-clumsy-as-he-is-stupid.a2:
Ensure that when defeated, both enemy players discard a card from their hand.
Ensure the teammate does not discard.

emissarys-sheathipede.ts:
Ensure that when defeated, each opponent may ready a resource, with each opponent deciding separately.
Ensure eliminated players are not offered the choice.
emissarys-sheathipede.a2:
Ensure that when defeated, both enemy players may ready a resource, each deciding separately.
Ensure the teammate is not offered the choice.

duchesss-investigators.ts:
Ensure that if you disclose Cunning from your hand, each opponent discards a random card from their hand.
Ensure that if you do not disclose (or can't), no opponent discards.
duchesss-investigators.a2:
Ensure that if you disclose Cunning, both enemy players each discard a random card, and the teammate does not.
Ensure disclosure uses only your own hand (a teammate's hand never counts), and the revealed card is seen by everyone, including your teammate.

rey#skywalker.ts:
Ensure no opponent can take control of this unit (test with at least two different opponents' control effects).
Ensure an ability controlled by any opponent that says "defeat a unit" can't defeat her, but -X/-X reducing her HP to 0 still does.
rey#skywalker.a2:
Ensure neither enemy player can take control of her, and abilities from either enemy can't defeat her directly.
Ensure a teammate's abilities are not "enemy" abilities, so a teammate's "defeat a unit" effect can defeat her.
Ensure a teammate is never an opponent, so a teammate's effect that takes control of her is not blocked.

c3po#die-jedi-dogs.ts:
Ensure that when played, you choose which one opponent takes control of this unit (any of the 2-3 opponents is selectable).
Ensure the Action can be used only by opponents of its current controller (including the original owner and the other opponents), and never by the controller.
Ensure damage equals its power including temporary modifiers, dealt to another ground unit.
c3po#die-jedi-dogs.a2:
Ensure only one of the two enemy players can be chosen to take control of it; the teammate can't be chosen.
Ensure the Action can be used by opponents of its current controller (the owner and the owner's teammate), and not by the controller's teammate.
Ensure damage equals its power including temporary modifiers, dealt to another ground unit.

wartime-profiteer.ts:
Ensure that when defeated, each opponent may ready a resource, with each opponent deciding separately.
Ensure eliminated players are not offered the choice.
wartime-profiteer.a2:
Ensure that when defeated, both enemy players may ready a resource, each deciding separately.
Ensure the teammate is not offered the choice.

ryder-azadi#restored-governor.ts:
Ensure the named card can't be played by any opponent while this unit is in play (check at least two opponents), but you can play it.
Ensure the restriction stays on all opponents of the original controller if an opponent takes control of Ryder, and ends when he leaves play.
Ensure Restore 1 heals your own base when he attacks.
ryder-azadi#restored-governor.a2:
Ensure the named card can't be played by either enemy player, and can be played by your teammate.
Ensure Restore 1 heals the base of the unit's controller (your own base), not the teammate's.

dookus-solar-sailer#droid-army-portent.ts:
Ensure that if you control a unit with printed cost 1 or less, each opponent discards a card from their hand.
Ensure that if you control none, no opponent discards; cost uses printed cost.
dookus-solar-sailer#droid-army-portent.a2:
Ensure the condition counts only units you control; a teammate's cost 1 or less unit does not satisfy it and no one discards.
Ensure that when it is met, both enemy players discard and the teammate does not.

giant-gorax.ts:
Ensure that if you control an Endor base, each opponent separately chooses one option: you deal 3 damage to a unit or base that opponent controls, or they discard a card and defeat one of their resources.
Ensure the 3 damage target is limited to that choosing opponent's own units/base, and that this works on both On Attack and When Defeated.
Ensure that without an Endor base nothing happens.
giant-gorax.a2:
Ensure the Endor base must be one you control; a teammate's Endor base does not enable it.
Ensure both enemy players each choose separately; the teammate chooses nothing, and the 3 damage can only hit an enemy's unit or base.
Ensure Overwhelm excess damage goes to the base of whoever controls the defending unit.

raddus#hope-of-the-resistance.ts:
Ensure while exhausted, cards played by every opponent cost 3 more, and while ready they do not.
Ensure Restore 3 heals 3 from your own base when he attacks.
raddus#hope-of-the-resistance.a2:
Ensure while exhausted, cards played by both enemy players cost 3 more.
Ensure the teammate's cards do not cost more.
Ensure Restore 3 heals your own base, not the teammate's.

count-dooku#silvertongued.ts:
Ensure each opponent can ready at most 1 ground unit and 1 space unit in the regroup phase (check at least two opponents, counted separately).
Ensure you are not limited, and When Played may exhaust any unit.
count-dooku#silvertongued.a2:
Ensure both enemy players are limited to 1 ground and 1 space unit readied in the regroup phase, each counted separately.
Ensure the teammate is not limited.
Ensure When Played may exhaust any unit, including a teammate's.

del-meeko#providing-overwatch.ts:
Ensure events played by each opponent cost 1 more (every opponent, not just one).
Ensure events played by Del Meeko's controller cost no more.
del-meeko#providing-overwatch.a2:
Ensure events played by either enemy cost 1 more.
Ensure events played by the teammate cost no more (teammate is not an opponent).

avenger#hunting-star-destroyer.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which opponent is "an opponent" (with 2-3 opponents), and only that opponent chooses and defeats one of their own non-leader units.
Ensure the other opponents' units are unaffected and a leader unit cannot be chosen.
Ensure the same applies for both When Played and On Attack.
avenger#hunting-star-destroyer.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies, and only that enemy chooses and defeats one of their own non-leader units.
Ensure the teammate is never the chosen opponent and the teammate's units are not defeated.

power-of-the-dark-side.ts:
Ensure the player who plays the event chooses which opponent is "an opponent"; only that opponent chooses one unit they control and it is defeated.
Ensure other opponents' units are unaffected.
power-of-the-dark-side.a2:
Ensure the player chooses one of the two enemies; only that enemy chooses and loses a unit.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen as the opponent.

vigilance.ts:
Ensure that if the discard mode is chosen, the player picks which single opponent's deck loses 6 cards from the top, and other opponents' decks are unchanged.
Ensure the other modes (heal a base, defeat a unit, Shield) behave as in 1v1.
vigilance.a2:
Ensure the discard mode can only target an enemy's deck, never the teammate's.
Ensure "Heal 5 damage from a base", "Defeat a unit" and "Give a Shield token to a unit" can target the teammate's base and units (no "enemy" restriction), and a base at 0 HP can still be healed.

seventh-sister#implacable-inquisitor.ts:
Ensure the attacker picks which opponent's base to attack, and the trigger's "that opponent" is the owner of the damaged base.
Ensure the 3 damage can only go to a ground unit controlled by that opponent, not another opponent's ground units.
seventh-sister#implacable-inquisitor.a2:
Ensure the trigger fires when combat damage is dealt to an enemy base and the 3 damage can only go to a ground unit that enemy controls.
Ensure a teammate's units cannot be chosen as the target, and a teammate's base cannot be attacked, so the trigger never fires for it.

chimaera#flagship-of-the-seventh-fleet.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which opponent is "an opponent"; only that opponent reveals their hand and discards a card with the named name.
Ensure other opponents' hands are not revealed.
chimaera#flagship-of-the-seventh-fleet.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies; only that enemy reveals their hand and discards a card with the named name.
Ensure the teammate's hand is not revealed or discarded from.
Ensure the revealed hand is seen by everyone, including both teammates.

i-had-no-choice.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which opponent is "an opponent", and that opponent (not the controller) chooses which of the up-to-2 units is returned to hand; the other goes to the bottom of its owner's deck.
Ensure the chosen opponent makes the choice even when the selected units belong to different players.
i-had-no-choice.a2:
Ensure the chooser is always one of the two enemies picked by the controller, never the teammate.
Ensure the teammate's units can still be among the chosen units (the card says "non-leader units", not enemy).
Ensure the unit returned to hand or deck bottom goes to its owner's zone.

spark-of-rebellion.ts: Ensure the player who plays it chooses which single opponent's hand is looked at and discards a card from it; other opponents' hands are unaffected.
spark-of-rebellion.a2:
Ensure the player chooses one of the two enemies' hands to look at and discard from.
Ensure the teammate's hand cannot be chosen.
Ensure only the player sees the hand (the teammate may be told but the game does not show it).

bodhi-rook#imperial-defector.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which single opponent's hand is looked at and that only a non-unit card from it can be discarded.
Ensure other opponents' hands are unaffected.
bodhi-rook#imperial-defector.a2:
Ensure the controller picks one of the two enemies' hands and can only discard a non-unit card from it.
Ensure the teammate's hand cannot be chosen.
Ensure only the controller sees the hand.

cunning.ts:
Ensure that if the discard mode is chosen, the player picks which single opponent discards a random card from their hand; other opponents are unaffected.
Ensure the other modes behave as in 1v1.
cunning.a2:
Ensure the discard mode can only target an enemy and a random card is discarded from that enemy's hand.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen for the discard mode.
Ensure the return, +4/+0 and exhaust modes can target the teammate's units (no "enemy" restriction).

cad-bane#he-who-needs-no-introduction.ts:
Ensure that, on the leader side and the deployed side, Cad Bane's controller chooses which opponent is "an opponent" and only that opponent chooses a unit they control to take 1 (leader) or 2 (deployed) damage.
Ensure the deployed ability's once-each-round limit is shared across all opponents (using it on one opponent prevents using it on another that round).
Ensure it triggers only on Underworld cards Cad Bane's controller plays, not other players' plays.
cad-bane#he-who-needs-no-introduction.a2:
Ensure the opponent is chosen from the two enemies and only that enemy chooses and damages one of their own units.
Ensure the teammate cannot be the chosen opponent.
Ensure it triggers only when Cad Bane's controller plays an Underworld card, not when the teammate does ("you play"), and the deployed once-each-round limit holds across both enemies.

poe-dameron#quick-to-improvise.ts:
Ensure that if the discard option is chosen, the controller picks which single opponent discards a card of their own choice from their hand.
Ensure each option can be chosen only once per attack, and the other options behave as in 1v1.
poe-dameron#quick-to-improvise.a2:
Ensure the discard option can only target an enemy, who chooses the card to discard; the teammate cannot be chosen.
Ensure "Deal 2 damage to a unit or base" can target the teammate's units and base (no "enemy" restriction).

stolen-landspeeder.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which single opponent takes control of it, and that opponent controls it afterward.
Ensure the Bounty is collected only by the owner defeating it while an opponent controls it (not by a different opponent), and then it returns from the owner's discard pile for free with an Experience token.
Ensure no When Played triggers if played from somewhere other than hand.
Ensure that if the controlling opponent is eliminated the unit goes to its owner's discard pile (tentative ruling 3a), and if the owner is eliminated it is removed.
stolen-landspeeder.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies to take control; the teammate cannot receive it.
Ensure the Bounty does not trigger for the owner if the teammate defeats it, since the teammate does not own it.

krayt-dragon.ts:
Ensure it triggers for each card played by any opponent, and the damage (equal to that card's printed cost) can only go to the base or a ground unit controlled by the player who played the card, not another opponent's.
Ensure plays by Krayt Dragon's controller do not trigger it.
krayt-dragon.a2:
Ensure it triggers for each card played by either enemy, and damage goes only to that enemy's base or one of their ground units.
Ensure the teammate's played cards do not trigger it and the teammate's base and units cannot be the target.

bazine-netal#spy-for-the-first-order.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent's hand is looked at, and only that opponent's hand.
Ensure the same opponent persists: the discarded card comes from that hand and that player draws.
Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
bazine-netal#spy-for-the-first-order.a2:
Ensure the controller can choose either enemy player and only the chosen enemy's hand is looked at, discarded from, and draws.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen as the opponent.

let-the-wookiee-win.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent is "an opponent", and that opponent chooses which mode the controller gets.
Ensure the other opponents make no choice and are unaffected.
Ensure the benefit goes to the controller: they ready up to 6 of their own resources, or ready a friendly unit and attack with it if it is a Wookiee.
let-the-wookiee-win.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies; only that enemy chooses the mode, and the teammate is never chosen.
Ensure the benefit goes to the controller: their own resources, or a friendly unit (which can be the teammate's).

q.t: If the controller readies a friendly Wookiee unit that belongs to the teammate, may the controller attack with it, even though an attack is never initiated with a teammate's unit?

grey-squadron-ywing.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent is "an opponent", and that opponent chooses a unit or base only from what they control.
Ensure the damage applies only to that choice; other opponents' units and bases cannot be selected.
grey-squadron-ywing.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies, who then picks only a unit or base they themselves control.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen and the teammate's units and base cannot be selected.

satine-kryze#committed-to-peace.ts:
Ensure the player using the granted ability (the unit's controller) chooses which opponent's deck is discarded from; the choice is per use.
Ensure for an enemy unit its controller's opponents include Satine's controller and the other players, and Satine's controller can be chosen.
Ensure discarding comes from the top of only the chosen opponent's deck.
satine-kryze#committed-to-peace.a2:
Ensure the unit's controller chooses which of its opponents' decks is discarded from; for a teammate's unit that is the same two enemies as for the controller's own units.
Ensure the teammate's deck can never be chosen as the opponent.
Ensure for an enemy unit the chosen opponent may be Satine's controller or Satine's teammate.

duchesss-champion.ts:
Ensure Sentinel is gained while any single opponent controls 3 or more units.
Ensure units split across opponents (no single opponent with 3) do not grant Sentinel.
Ensure an eliminated player's units are not counted.
duchesss-champion.a2:
Ensure Sentinel is gained while either enemy individually controls 3 or more units.
Ensure units split across the two enemies (nothing summed) do not grant Sentinel.
Ensure the teammate's units do not count toward the 3.

kiadimundi#composed-and-confident.ts:
Ensure each opponent is tracked separately: it triggers when any one opponent plays their own second card that phase.
Ensure the controller (not the opponent) draws 2 cards, and each opponent can trigger it once per phase.
Ensure cards played by non-opponents (other than the opponent in question) are not counted toward "their second card".
kiadimundi#composed-and-confident.a2:
Ensure it triggers when either enemy plays their own second card that phase.
Ensure the teammate's plays never trigger it or count as an opponent's plays.
Ensure "their second card" is counted per enemy player: one card from each enemy does not trigger it, and an enemy's own second card does.

the-invasion-of-christophsis.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses one opponent and only that player's units are defeated.
Ensure other opponents' units and the controller's own units survive.
the-invasion-of-christophsis.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one enemy and only that enemy's units are defeated; the other enemy's units survive.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen and the teammate's units are not defeated.

republic-defense-carrier.ts:
Ensure the discount equals the unit count of the single opponent who controls the most units, not the sum across opponents.
Ensure it updates if the leading opponent changes, and eliminated players are not considered.
republic-defense-carrier.a2:
Ensure the discount equals the unit count of whichever enemy controls the most units, not the sum of both enemies.
Ensure the teammate's units are never counted (the teammate is not an opponent).

jesse#hardfighting-patriot.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent creates the 2 Battle Droid tokens, and that opponent creates and controls them.
Ensure the other opponents get no tokens and the controller gets none.
jesse#hardfighting-patriot.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies, who creates and controls the 2 tokens.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen and gets no tokens.

old-access-codes.ts:
Ensure the card is drawn if any single opponent controls more units than the controller; compare against each opponent individually, not the total.
Ensure no draw if no single opponent controls more units than you.
Ensure eliminated players are not compared.
old-access-codes.a2:
Ensure the card is drawn if either enemy individually controls more units than you.
Ensure only your own units count for "you"; the teammate's units are not added to your count and the teammate is not an opponent.

ahsoka-tano#always-ready-for-trouble.ts:
Ensure Ambush is gained while the controller controls fewer units than any one opponent (counting this unit); no opponent is chosen, and it is lost when no opponent controls more.
Ensure the action ability to return her and her upgrades behaves as in 1v1.
ahsoka-tano#always-ready-for-trouble.a2:
Ensure Ambush is gained when you control fewer units than either enemy individually; nothing is summed across the two enemies, and only your own units count for you.
Ensure the teammate's units are never counted as an opponent's units.
Ensure the action ability behaves as in 1v1.

lux-bonteri#renegade-separatist.ts:
Ensure it triggers when any opponent plays a card for fewer resources than the card's printed cost; "that opponent" is the player who played the card.
Ensure each opponent's payment is evaluated separately and the controller chooses the unit to ready or exhaust.
Ensure the controller's own plays do not trigger it.
lux-bonteri#renegade-separatist.a2:
Ensure it triggers for either enemy's play when that enemy paid less than the printed cost.
Ensure the teammate's plays never trigger it, even when the teammate paid less.
Ensure the controller chooses the unit to ready or exhaust.

political-pressure.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent is chosen; only that opponent decides whether to discard a random card.
Ensure if they don't discard, the 2 Battle Droids are created by the card's controller (not the chosen opponent).
Ensure other opponents are unaffected.
political-pressure.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies; only that enemy decides, and only that enemy's hand is discarded from.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen, and the tokens are created under the controller, not the teammate.

unmasking-the-conspiracy.ts:
Ensure the controller discards from their own hand first; only if they do, the controller chooses an opponent.
Ensure the chosen opponent's hand is looked at and the discard comes from that same hand.
Ensure if no card was discarded, no opponent is chosen and nothing happens.
unmasking-the-conspiracy.a2:
Ensure only an enemy can be chosen; the teammate's hand cannot be looked at or discarded from by this effect.
Ensure only the controller sees the looked-at hand (the teammate may be told).
Ensure the first discard comes from the controller's own hand only.

aggrieved-parliamentarian.ts:
Ensure the player who played the unit chooses which opponent is affected.
Ensure only the chosen opponent's discard pile is shuffled and put on the bottom of their deck; other opponents' discard piles are unchanged.
aggrieved-parliamentarian.a2:
Ensure the player chooses one of the two enemy players, and only that enemy's discard pile is shuffled and put on the bottom of their deck.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen and the teammate's discard pile is unchanged.

admiral-trench#chkchkchkchk.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which opponent is "an opponent" when the ability resolves, and only that opponent discards 2 of the 4 revealed cards.
Ensure the other opponents take no part; the controlling player draws 1 of the remaining 2 and discards the other.
admiral-trench#chkchkchkchk.a2:
Ensure the controlling player chooses one of the two enemy players, and only that enemy discards 2 of the revealed cards.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen and does not discard or choose anything.

youre-all-clear-kid.ts:
Ensure the defeated unit can be any opponent's space unit.
Ensure the "an opponent controls no space units" check is true if any one opponent controls none, with no opponent chosen.
youre-all-clear-kid.a2:
Ensure the teammate's space units cannot be the defeated unit and are not counted as an opponent's space units.
Ensure the "an opponent controls no space units" check is true if either enemy individually controls none.

seasoned-fleet-admiral.ts:
Ensure it triggers when any one opponent draws 1 or more cards during the action phase, including opponents who are not the active player.
Ensure it does not trigger when you draw, or when an opponent draws outside the action phase (e.g. regroup).
seasoned-fleet-admiral.a2:
Ensure it triggers when either enemy draws 1 or more cards during the action phase.
Ensure it does not trigger when the teammate draws, or when you draw.

air-superiority.ts:
Ensure the condition is true if you control more space units than any one opponent, with no opponent chosen for the comparison.
Ensure the controller chooses an opponent they outnumber in space units, and the 4 damage goes to a ground unit that opponent controls. Ensure an opponent with as many or more space units cannot be chosen.
air-superiority.a2:
Ensure only the space units you control count for you; the teammate's space units count for no one.
Ensure the condition is true if you control more than either enemy individually, and the 4 damage can only go to an enemy ground unit, never the teammate's.
Ensure the controller chooses one enemy they outnumber in space units, and the 4 damage goes to a ground unit that enemy controls; an enemy with as many or more space units cannot be chosen.

timely-reinforcements.ts:
Ensure the player chooses one opponent, and the number of X-Wing tokens is based only on that opponent's resources (1 per 2 resources).
Ensure the tokens are created under your control.
timely-reinforcements.a2:
Ensure the player chooses one enemy, and the number of tokens is based only on that enemy's resources; the teammate's resources are not counted and the teammate cannot be chosen.
Ensure the tokens are created under your control.

they-hate-that-ship.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which opponent is "an opponent" when the ability resolves; only that opponent creates the 2 TIE Fighter tokens and readies them.
Ensure triggers from the token creation resolve after the event finishes, and that you then play a Vehicle from your hand for 3 less.
they-hate-that-ship.a2:
Ensure the controlling player chooses one of the two enemy players, and only that enemy creates and readies the TIE Fighter tokens.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen and does not receive tokens.

moff-gideon#i-know-everything.ts:
Ensure that when Gideon deals combat damage to a base, only the opponent who owns that base has their played units cost 1 more this phase.
Ensure the other opponents and you are unaffected, and the increase remains if Gideon is defeated.
moff-gideon#i-know-everything.a2:
Ensure only the enemy whose base was damaged has their played units cost 1 more this phase; the other enemy is unaffected.
Ensure you and your teammate are unaffected, and that damage to the teammate's base (if possible) is not an opponent's base and does not trigger it.

ahsoka-tano#chasing-whispers.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which opponent is "an opponent" when the ability resolves, and that opponent discards a card of their choice from their hand.
Ensure other opponents' hands are untouched, and that if the discarded card is a unit you may exhaust any unit.
ahsoka-tano#chasing-whispers.a2:
Ensure the controlling player chooses one of the two enemy players, and only that enemy discards a card from their hand.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen, and that a discarded unit lets you exhaust a unit.

home-one#on-my-mark.ts: Ensure the cost reduction applies if any one opponent controls 3 or more space units; space units are not combined across opponents (2 and 2 does not qualify).
home-one#on-my-mark.a2: Ensure the teammate's space units do not count, and the discount applies when either enemy individually controls 3 or more space units; 2 and 2 across the two enemies does not qualify.

jam-communications.ts:
Ensure the player chooses which opponent's hand to look at, and only that player's hand is seen and has an event discarded.
Ensure the other opponents' hands are untouched.
jam-communications.a2:
Ensure the player chooses one of the two enemy players, and only that enemy's hand is looked at and has an event discarded.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen, and only you (not your teammate) see the revealed hand (you may tell them).

never-tell-me-the-odds.ts:
Ensure the player chooses one opponent, and the 3 cards are discarded from that opponent's deck only (top of deck) and 3 from your own deck.
Ensure damage equals the number of odd printed-cost cards among the 6 discarded, and may target any unit.
never-tell-me-the-odds.a2:
Ensure the player chooses one of the two enemy players, and 3 cards are discarded from only that enemy's deck plus 3 from your own deck.
Ensure the teammate's deck is not affected and the teammate cannot be chosen.

its-a-trap.ts:
Ensure the condition is true if any one opponent controls more space units than you, with no opponent chosen; nothing is summed across opponents.
Ensure that when the condition is met, each space unit you control readies.
its-a-trap.a2:
Ensure the condition is true if either enemy individually controls more space units than you; nothing is summed across the two enemies.
Ensure the teammate's space units are not counted as yours or as an opponent's and are not readied; only your own space units ready.

stolen-athauler.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses one opponent when the unit is defeated, and only that opponent may play it from its owner's discard pile for free this phase.
Ensure the other opponents cannot play it, and the chosen opponent still needs to be able to take an action to play it.
stolen-athauler.a2:
Ensure only the chosen enemy may play it from the discard pile for free this phase; the other enemy cannot.
Ensure the teammate (and the unit's owner/controller) cannot be chosen and gain no permission to play it.

cal-kestis#i-cant-keep-hiding.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which one opponent is "an opponent" (both for the leader Action and the deployed On Attack).
Ensure only the chosen opponent chooses and exhausts one of their own ready units; other opponents' units are unaffected.
cal-kestis#i-cant-keep-hiding.a2:
Ensure the controlling player can choose only an enemy player as "an opponent"; the teammate cannot be chosen and the teammate's units are never exhausted by this.
Ensure only the chosen enemy chooses and exhausts one of their own ready units.

the-tragedy-of-plagueis.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which one opponent is "an opponent"; only that opponent chooses and defeats one of their own units.
Ensure the friendly-unit protection applies only to the chosen friendly unit (behaves as in 1v1 otherwise).
the-tragedy-of-plagueis.a2:
Ensure the "friendly unit" can be the teammate's unit as well as your own.
Ensure "an opponent" can only be an enemy player (not the teammate), and only that enemy chooses and defeats one of their own units.

watto#no-money-no-parts-no-deal.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which one opponent is "an opponent"; only that opponent makes the choice between the two modes.
Ensure "You" in both modes still refers to Watto's controller (they give the Experience token to their own friendly unit or draw the card), not the choosing opponent.
watto#no-money-no-parts-no-deal.a2:
Ensure "an opponent" can only be an enemy player, chosen by Watto's controller, and only that enemy makes the mode choice.
Ensure the Experience token can go to a friendly unit controlled by the teammate (friendly includes the teammate).
Ensure the draw mode makes only Watto's controller draw, not the teammate.

terentatek.ts:
Ensure Terentatek gains Ambush while any one opponent controls a Force unit, and loses it when no opponent does.
Ensure a Force unit controlled by an eliminated player no longer counts.
terentatek.a2:
Ensure Terentatek gains Ambush while either enemy player controls a Force unit.
Ensure a Force unit controlled by the teammate does not give Ambush (a teammate is not an opponent).

adi-gallia#stern-and-focused.ts:
Ensure Adi triggers when any opponent plays an event, and the 1 damage goes to the base of the opponent who played it (not another opponent's base).
Ensure events played by Adi's controller do not trigger it.
adi-gallia#stern-and-focused.a2:
Ensure Adi triggers when either enemy plays an event, with 1 damage to that enemy's base.
Ensure an event played by the teammate does not trigger it, and neither does one played by Adi's controller.

tip-the-scale.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which one opponent's hand to look at, and the discard comes only from that opponent's hand.
Ensure the other opponents' hands are not looked at or affected.
tip-the-scale.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player's hand can be chosen; the teammate's hand cannot be chosen for the look or the discard.
Ensure the discard comes only from the chosen enemy's hand.

dedra-meero#not-wasting-time.ts:
Ensure the leader Action can target an enemy unit controlled by any opponent, and that unit's controller (not Dedra's controller) decides whether to deal 2 damage to it; if they don't, Dedra's controller draws.
Ensure the deployed Raid 2 applies while Dedra's controller has more cards in hand than any one opponent, with no opponent chosen, and not when no opponent has fewer.
dedra-meero#not-wasting-time.a2:
Ensure the leader Action can target an enemy unit of either enemy player but not the teammate's units (not enemy); the unit's controller decides on the 2 damage.
Ensure the deployed Raid 2 applies when you have more cards in hand than either enemy individually; the teammate's hand size never grants or denies Raid 2.

cassian-andor#climb.ts:
Ensure a friendly unit that has damaged any one opponent's base this phase can't be attacked (unless it has Sentinel); a unit that only damaged a non-opponent or nothing is attackable.
Ensure the deployed side's "while you have the initiative" works as in 1v1 (initiative is held by one player).
cassian-andor#climb.a2:
Ensure the leader ability protects the teammate's units too (friendly includes the teammate) once they have damaged an enemy base this phase.
Ensure the deployed Cassian's "while you have the initiative" applies when the teammate took the initiative, since the initiative is the team's.

galen-erso#youll-never-win.ts:
Ensure every non-leader card with the named card name owned by any opponent loses all abilities (and can't gain abilities), in play or not, not just one chosen opponent's.
Ensure the player's own cards with that name are unaffected, and the effect ends when Galen leaves play.
galen-erso#youll-never-win.a2:
Ensure the named non-leader cards owned by both enemy players lose all abilities.
Ensure cards with that name owned by the teammate keep their abilities (a teammate is not an opponent).

corrupt-politician.ts: Ensure Corrupt Politician has Sentinel while its controller controls more units than any one opponent, with no opponent chosen, and lacks it when no opponent controls fewer.
corrupt-politician.a2:
Ensure the count of units "you control" includes only your own units, not the teammate's.
Ensure Sentinel is gained when you control more units than either enemy individually; the teammate is never an opponent and nothing is summed across the two enemies.

theed-security.ts:
Ensure the condition is true when any one opponent controls an upgrade, and false when only the controller (or no one other) controls upgrades.
Ensure the Experience token may go to any unit (including another player's), chosen by the controller.
theed-security.a2:
Ensure an upgrade controlled by the teammate does not satisfy the condition; an upgrade controlled by either enemy does.
Ensure the Experience token may be given to any unit, including the teammate's.

trade-route-taxation.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which one opponent is chosen; the units comparison is against that opponent only.
Ensure only the chosen opponent can't play events this phase (when the condition is met); other opponents can still play events.
trade-route-taxation.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player can be chosen; the teammate cannot be chosen.
Ensure "you control" counts only the player's own units (not the teammate's), and only the chosen enemy is restricted from playing events; the other enemy and the teammate can still play events.

kazuda-xiono#im-not-a-spy.ts:
Ensure +2/+0 applies while the controller has fewer resources than any one opponent, with no opponent chosen.
Ensure Raid 2 works as in 1v1.
kazuda-xiono#im-not-a-spy.a2:
Ensure the resource comparison uses only the player's own resources (the teammate's resources are not "yours") and is made against each enemy individually, never the teammate.
Ensure +2/+0 applies when you have fewer resources than either enemy; nothing is summed across the two enemies.

luthens-haulcraft#countermeasures-armed.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which one opponent when using the ability, and only that opponent discards 2 cards from their hand if the disclose succeeds.
Ensure no opponent discards if the disclose is not completed or the controller declines.
luthens-haulcraft#countermeasures-armed.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player can be chosen; the teammate can't be chosen and never discards.
Ensure the disclosed cards are revealed to everyone, including the teammate, and that only the controller's own hand and aspects can satisfy the aspect icons; the teammate's hand never counts.

corellian-hounds.ts:
Ensure the unit enters play ready if any one opponent controls no ground units, with no opponent chosen.
Ensure an eliminated player is not counted as an opponent for this check.
corellian-hounds.a2:
Ensure a teammate's ground units never prevent the unit from entering ready.
Ensure it enters ready when either enemy individually controls no ground units, even if the other enemy controls ground units.

garindan#information-broker.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent's hand is looked at, and that the discard comes from that same opponent's hand (the choice persists).
Ensure other opponents' hands are untouched even if they hold a card with the named name.
garindan#information-broker.a2:
Ensure the controller can choose either enemy player, and cannot choose the teammate.
Ensure the discard comes only from the chosen enemy's hand, not the teammate's or the other enemy's.

grand-admiral-thrawn#grand-schemer.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent is "an opponent"; only that opponent may choose a non-leader unit they control to be captured, and the choice persists through the ability.
Ensure When Defeated lets the unit capture a non-leader unit controlled by any opponent in the same arena.
grand-admiral-thrawn#grand-schemer.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemy players as "an opponent"; the teammate is never offered the choice.
Ensure When Defeated can use a friendly unit controlled by the teammate as the captor, and can only capture an enemy (either enemy player's) non-leader unit in the same arena, never a teammate's unit.

fully-armed-and-operational.ts:
Ensure an attack on another player's base does not satisfy the condition.
Ensure "their previous action" is that opponent's own most recent action this phase, even if other players acted in between.
fully-armed-and-operational.a2:
Ensure an attack by the teammate on an enemy, or an attack on the teammate's base, does not satisfy "an opponent attacked your base".
Ensure "their previous action" is the previous action of the enemy player who attacked, not the enemy team's last action.

cikatro-vizago#business-is-what-matters.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent may pay 1 resource, and that opponent alone pays or declines.
Ensure if the chosen opponent pays, the revealed card goes facedown on top of the deck; if not, the controller draws it. Other opponents are not asked.
cikatro-vizago#business-is-what-matters.a2:
Ensure the controller can only choose an enemy player, never the teammate.
Ensure only the chosen enemy's own resources can be paid; the teammate cannot pay on their behalf.

charged-with-espionage.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent's hand is looked at and the unit is discarded from that opponent's hand only.
Ensure the disclose uses only the controller's own hand and behaves as in 1v1.
charged-with-espionage.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses either enemy player's hand to look at, never the teammate's; the look is private to the controller.
Ensure the disclose uses only the controller's own hand and aspects, the teammate's hand never counts, and the disclosed cards are seen by everyone including the teammate.

beguile.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses the opponent whose hand is looked at, and the unit returned to hand must be a non-leader unit with printed cost 6 or less controlled by that same opponent.
Ensure units of other opponents cannot be chosen.
beguile.a2:
Ensure the controller can choose either enemy player, and the returned unit must be controlled by that same enemy.
Ensure the teammate's units cannot be chosen and the teammate's hand cannot be looked at.

viper-probe-droid.ts: Ensure the controller chooses which opponent's hand is looked at; only the controller sees it.
viper-probe-droid.a2: Ensure the controller can choose either enemy player, never the teammate; only the controller sees it (they may tell the teammate).

inspectors-shuttle.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent reveals their hand, and the Experience tokens count only cards with the named name in that opponent's hand.
Ensure other opponents' hands are not revealed or counted.
inspectors-shuttle.a2:
Ensure the controller can choose either enemy player, never the teammate; only that enemy's hand is revealed and counted.
Ensure the revealed hand is seen by everyone, including the teammate.

tobias-beckett#people-are-predictable.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent takes control of the chosen friendly unit, and a Credit is created only if that opponent takes control.
Ensure Deployed defeats units the controller owns but any opponent controls.
tobias-beckett#people-are-predictable.a2:
Ensure the chosen friendly unit can be the teammate's unit (friendly includes the teammate), and the unit goes to a chosen enemy player, never the teammate.
Ensure Deployed can defeat a unit you own that the teammate controls ("you control" counts only your own cards).

vel-sartha#aldhani-insurgent.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent creates the Credit token, and only that opponent gets one.
Ensure on the deployed side the Credit is created only if the controller chose to give the Experience token.
vel-sartha#aldhani-insurgent.a2:
Ensure the Credit goes to a chosen enemy player, never the teammate.
Ensure the Experience token can be given to any unit, including the teammate's.

tear-this-ship-apart.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent's resources are looked at, and that same opponent resources the top card of their deck if a card is played.
Ensure the card played comes from that opponent's resources only.
tear-this-ship-apart.a2:
Ensure the controller can choose either enemy player, never the teammate; only that enemy's resources can be looked at or played from.
Ensure the teammate's resources are not available to the controller.

luke-skywalker#profit-or-be-destroyed.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent decides between the two modes, and that opponent makes the choice.
Ensure "They create a Credit" gives the token to that opponent, and the controller deals 5 damage if the other mode is chosen.
luke-skywalker#profit-or-be-destroyed.a2:
Ensure the controller can choose either enemy player to choose the mode, never the teammate.
Ensure the Credit token goes to that enemy.

broken-horn#vizagos-pride.ts:
Ensure each comparison (hand size, resources) is true if any one opponent has more, evaluated independently; no opponent is chosen.
Ensure eliminated players are not counted in the comparison.
broken-horn#vizagos-pride.a2:
Ensure each comparison is true if either enemy individually has more; nothing is summed across the two enemies and each sentence is evaluated independently.
Ensure the teammate's hand and resources are never used in the comparison.

you-hold-this.ts:
Ensure the player who plays the event chooses which opponent takes control of the unit, and the same opponent is used for the whole ability.
Ensure the 4 damage is dealt only if control actually changed, to another unit in the same arena as the given unit.
Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
you-hold-this.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player can be chosen to take control (never the teammate); either enemy may be chosen.
Ensure a teammate's non-leader unit can be chosen as the friendly unit (friendly includes the teammate).
Ensure the 4 damage is dealt only if control changed, to another unit in the same arena.

twofaced-troig.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent takes control of Troig, and Credit tokens are created only if control actually changed.
Ensure the 2 Credit tokens are created for the original controller, not the new one.
Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
twofaced-troig.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player can take control of Troig (never the teammate); either enemy may be chosen.
Ensure the 2 Credit tokens go to the player who played Troig, not the teammate.

targeted-for-removal.ts:
Ensure the player controlling the ability chooses which opponent creates the Credit tokens when the unit is defeated, and that opponent receives all of them.
Ensure the amount equals the defeated unit's printed cost, not its modified cost.
Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
targeted-for-removal.a2:
Ensure the Credit tokens go to a chosen enemy player, never the teammate; either enemy may be chosen.
Ensure the amount equals the printed cost, not the modified cost.

mid-rim-sharpshooter.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which one opponent discards a card from their hand, and only that opponent's hand is affected.
Ensure the discard happens only if the 1 resource was paid.
Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
mid-rim-sharpshooter.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player discards (either enemy may be chosen); the teammate's hand is never affected.
Ensure the discard happens only if the 1 resource was paid.

commence-the-festivities.ts:
Ensure the attack is made with one of the player's own ready units, which gains Saboteur for this attack.
Ensure the +2/+0 applies if any one opponent controls more resources than the player; no opponent is chosen.
Ensure an eliminated player's resources are never compared.
commence-the-festivities.a2:
Ensure the attack is made with the player's own unit (a teammate's unit cannot be used).
Ensure the +2/+0 applies if either enemy individually controls more resources than the player; nothing is summed across enemies.
Ensure the teammate's resources are not counted for either side.

jabbas-rancor#snack-time.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and that opponent (not the controller) chooses a ground unit they control, then the controller may deal 7 damage to it.
Ensure the chosen opponent need not be the player being attacked.
Ensure nothing happens if the chosen opponent controls no ground unit. Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
jabbas-rancor#snack-time.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player can be chosen, and the chosen enemy picks a ground unit they control; the teammate's units are never chosen.
Ensure the chosen enemy need not be the player being attacked.

galen-erso#destroying-his-creation.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent takes control of Galen when played, and only if the player chooses to.
Ensure the Raid 1 and Saboteur grant applies to enemy units of Galen's current controller, i.e. every other non-eliminated player's units, including the original player's units after control changes.
Ensure the grant is recalculated when control changes and the controller's own units do not gain it.
galen-erso#destroying-his-creation.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player can take control of Galen (never the teammate).
Ensure the Raid 1 and Saboteur grant applies to both enemy players' units and not to the controller's or the teammate's units.
Ensure that if an enemy takes control, the original controller's and teammate's units become enemy units and gain the keywords, while the new controller's teammate's units do not.

mother-talzin#stealing-the-spirit.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses one opponent and the same opponent's hand is looked at, discarded from, and draws the replacement card, with the discard going to that opponent's discard pile.
Ensure that if the discarded card is a unit, the controller may play it this phase from that opponent's discard pile, ignoring aspect penalties and paying its cost.
Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
mother-talzin#stealing-the-spirit.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player's hand can be looked at (either enemy); the teammate's hand is never chosen.
Ensure the chosen enemy discards and draws, and a discarded unit can be played from that enemy's discard pile under the controller's control, paying its cost.

kouhun-assassination.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent may discard a card from their hand, and only that opponent decides whether to discard.
Ensure the -8/-8 is given to a non-Vehicle unit only if that opponent discarded.
Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
kouhun-assassination.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player can be chosen to discard (either enemy); the teammate's hand is never affected.
Ensure the -8/-8 applies only if that enemy discarded, to a non-Vehicle unit, which may be any player's, including the teammate's.

wartime-refugee.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent heals 1 damage from their base, and only that opponent's base is healed.
Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
wartime-refugee.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player's base is healed (either enemy); the teammate's base is never healed.
Ensure an enemy base at 0 HP can still be healed (bases at 0 remaining health can still be healed).

wartime-mercenaries.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent may give the Experience token, and that opponent makes the may decision and chooses the unit.
Ensure the chosen opponent may choose any unit, including units they do not control.
Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
wartime-mercenaries.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player can be chosen (either enemy); that enemy makes the decision and picks the unit.
Ensure the teammate does not make the choice, though the teammate's units can be selected as the target.

wartime-pirate.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent deals 1 damage, and that opponent chooses the unit (any unit, including their own or the controller's).
Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
wartime-pirate.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player can be chosen (either enemy); that enemy chooses the unit, which may be any unit including the teammate's.
Ensure the teammate is never the one choosing.

arms-deal.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses one opponent, and only the controller and that opponent each draw 2 cards; the other opponents draw nothing.
Ensure an eliminated player cannot be chosen.
arms-deal.a2: Ensure only the controller and one chosen enemy draw 2 cards each; the teammate and the other enemy draw nothing.

sabine-wren#bargaining-on-belief.ts:
Ensure the leader-side Action has the controller choose one opponent, who gives 2 Advantage tokens to a unit they control; Shielded is granted only if they did (an opponent with no units cannot).
Ensure the next unit the controller plays this phase gains Shielded.
Ensure the deployed On Attack has no opponent choice and behaves as in 1v1, and remains active even if Sabine is defeated before the next unit is played.
sabine-wren#bargaining-on-belief.a2:
Ensure only an enemy player can be chosen to give the Advantage tokens to a unit they control (either enemy); the teammate is never chosen.
Ensure Shielded applies only to the next unit Sabine's controller plays; a unit the teammate plays does not use it up or gain it.
Ensure the deployed On Attack behaves as in 1v1, and remains active even if Sabine is defeated before the next unit is played.

ninth-sister#hulking-inquisitor.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which one opponent discards, and the other opponents do not discard.
Ensure the damage equals the discarded card's printed cost and can be divided among any units, including other opponents' units.
ninth-sister#hulking-inquisitor.a2:
Ensure the controller can choose either enemy as the discarding opponent, and the teammate cannot be chosen.
Ensure the damage can be divided among any units, including the teammate's units.

rash-action.ts:
Ensure only the opponent whose base took combat damage from this attack discards a card; other opponents do not.
Ensure no one discards if the attacker dealt no combat damage to an opponent's base (e.g. it attacked a unit).
rash-action.a2:
Ensure only the enemy whose base took combat damage discards; the other enemy and the teammate do not.
Ensure the attack is made with one of your own units, not the teammate's.

whistling-birds.ts:
Ensure only units controlled by the opponent whose base took combat damage take 2 damage, and only those in the attacker's arena.
Ensure other opponents' units in that arena are not damaged.
whistling-birds.a2: Ensure only the damaged enemy's units in the arena take 2 damage; the other enemy's units and the teammate's units are not damaged.

remnant-lookouts.ts: Ensure the controller chooses which one opponent's hand is looked at, and that same opponent is the 'they' who draws if a card is discarded.
remnant-lookouts.a2:
Ensure the controller can choose either enemy's hand, never the teammate's, and that enemy draws if a card is discarded.
Ensure only the controller sees the hand through this effect.

helix-starfighter.ts:
Ensure it gets a Shield if at least one opponent controls a space unit, and 2 Advantage tokens only if no opponent does.
Ensure no opponent is chosen for the condition; any one qualifying opponent is enough.
helix-starfighter.a2:
Ensure only an enemy's space unit gives the Shield; a space unit controlled by the teammate does not count.
Ensure it gets 2 Advantage tokens if only the teammate controls a space unit.

elzar-mann#haunted-by-a-vision.ts:

general-grievous#separatist-warlord.ts:

talzins-shuttle#mysterious-arrival.ts:

talzins-shuttle#mysterious-arrival.a2:

imagun-di#holding-out-for-resupply.ts:

garnac#let-the-hunt-begin.ts:

saw-gerrera#shadowlands-insurgent.ts:

babwa-venomor#burning-kashyyyk.ts: Ensure the controller chooses which one opponent creates the Beast token, and only that opponent gets and controls it.

crosshair#ive-changed.ts:

cid-scaleback#cant-be-trusted.ts:

therm-scissorpunch#boastful-gambler.ts:

mon-cal-cruiser.ts:

separatist-harbinger.ts:

surveillance-cruiser.ts:

cham-syndulla#rallying-ryloth.ts:

fear-and-dead-men.a2:

Ensure only cards discarded from the controller's own hand reduce the cost, not the teammate's discards.

thermal-detonator.ts: Ensure that when the ready attached unit is defeated, 2 damage is dealt to each ground unit of every opponent and none to the controller's own units.
thermal-detonator.a2:
Ensure ground units of both enemy players take 2 damage and the teammate's units take none.
Ensure this holds when the upgrade is attached to the teammate's unit.

first-battle-memorial.ts:
Ensure a player with both leaders deployed gives 2 Experience tokens, one for each friendly leader unit, and that the Experience can go to any unit (own or an opponent's).
Ensure a player with one deployed leader (other leader undeployed) gives only 1.
first-battle-memorial.a2:
Ensure the teammate's deployed leader unit counts as a friendly leader unit for the number of Experience tokens.
Ensure the Experience can be given to any unit, including the teammate's.

dookus-palace.ts:
Ensure the cost reduction counts both of the controller's deployed leader units (up to 2) and no opponent's leader units.
Ensure the played unit comes only from the controller's hand.
dookus-palace.a2:
Ensure the teammate's deployed leader unit counts toward the cost reduction.
Ensure the unit is played from the controller's own hand and paid with the controller's own resources and aspects.

executioners-arena.ts:
Ensure a player with both leaders deployed gets 2 separate 2-damage instances (same unit or different units), dealt simultaneously, and can target any unit including opponents' units.
Ensure only the controller's own leader units count.
executioners-arena.a2:
Ensure the teammate's deployed leader unit counts as a friendly leader unit for the number of 2-damage instances.
Ensure the teammate's units are legal targets for the damage.

sundari-palace.ts:
Ensure a player with both leaders deployed can resource and ready up to 2 cards from hand, and exactly that many friendly resources are defeated at the start of the regroup phase.
Ensure only the controller's own leader units count and only the controller's own hand is used.
sundari-palace.a2: Ensure the teammate's deployed leader unit counts toward the number of cards that may be resourced, and the cards come only from the controller's own hand.

q.t: At the start of regroup, may the defeated "friendly resources" include the teammate's resources, or only the controller's own?

coleman-trebor#jedi-rescuer.ts:
Ensure 1 damage is dealt to the base of every opponent (3 bases in a 4-player game) and the controller heals 1 from their own base per damage dealt (the total across all bases).
Ensure a base brought to 0 by this is eliminated as per Twin Suns rules.
coleman-trebor#jedi-rescuer.a2:
Ensure 1 damage is dealt to both enemy bases and never to the teammate's base.
Ensure the controller heals their own base 1 per damage dealt (2 total), not the teammate's base.

prime-minister-almec#scheming-populist.ts: Ensure each opponent's units in the boosted unit's arena with less power than it (including the +2 bonus) are exhausted, for all opponents, while units with equal or greater power and units in the other arena are not.
prime-minister-almec#scheming-populist.a2:
Ensure the +2/+2 can be given to the teammate's unit, and then both enemies' units in that unit's arena with less power are exhausted.
Ensure the teammate's units are never exhausted by this.

ziton-moj#sowing-chaos.ts:
Ensure 1 damage is dealt to a unit of each non-eliminated player, including the controller's own, simultaneously, and a player with no units is skipped.
Ensure with 3 and 4 players that every player gets exactly one damaged unit.
ziton-moj#sowing-chaos.a2:
Ensure 1 damage is dealt to one unit of each of the four players, including the controller and the teammate, simultaneously.
Ensure a player with no units is skipped.

take-cover.ts:
Ensure the cost reduction counts both of the controller's deployed leader units (up to 2) and no opponent's leader units.
Ensure the heal and Shield can target any unit, including an opponent's.
take-cover.a2:
Ensure the teammate's deployed leader unit counts toward the cost reduction.
Ensure the heal and Shield can target the teammate's unit.

vanquish-the-legion.ts: Ensure every opponent's ground units get -2/-2 for the phase (all opponents), while space units, the controller's own units, and units that enter later are unaffected.
vanquish-the-legion.a2:
Ensure both enemies' ground units get -2/-2 for the phase.
Ensure the teammate's ground units are not affected.

galactic-escalation.ts:
Ensure every non-eliminated player, including the controller, resources the top card of their own deck exhausted.
Ensure this works with 3 and 4 players.
galactic-escalation.a2: Ensure all four players, including the controller and the teammate, each resource the top card of their own deck exhausted.

take-charge.ts:
Ensure the cost reduction counts both of the controller's deployed leader units (up to 2) and no opponent's leader units.
Ensure the Experience tokens can go to up to 3 units in any combination of the controller's and opponents' units.
take-charge.a2:
Ensure the teammate's deployed leader unit counts toward the cost reduction.
Ensure the Experience tokens can go to the teammate's units.

backed-by-black-sun.ts:
Ensure the first damage must target an enemy unit of any opponent, and the second damage equals the number of damaged units controlled by all opponents combined (not just one opponent), including the unit just damaged.
Ensure the second damage can target any unit, including the controller's own.
backed-by-black-sun.a2:
Ensure the count of damaged enemy units includes both enemies' units and excludes the teammate's damaged units.
Ensure the second damage can target the teammate's unit, while the first must target an enemy unit.

take-action.ts:
Ensure the cost reduction counts both of the controller's deployed leader units (up to 2) and no opponent's leader units.
Ensure the 3 damage can target any unit, including an opponent's.
take-action.a2:
Ensure the teammate's deployed leader unit counts toward the cost reduction.
Ensure the 3 damage can target the teammate's unit.

take-aim.ts:
Ensure the cost reduction counts both of the controller's leaders when both are deployed as units (2 resources less).
Ensure an opponent's deployed leader units do not reduce the cost.
take-aim.a2:
Ensure the cost reduction counts the controller's deployed leader unit and the teammate's deployed leader unit (2 resources less when both are deployed).
Ensure an enemy's deployed leader units do not reduce the cost.

domesticated-lothcat.ts:
Ensure units controlled by every opponent lose Ambush and Support, including units as they are played.
Ensure the controller's own units keep Ambush and Support.
domesticated-lothcat.a2:
Ensure units controlled by both enemies lose Ambush and Support, including units as they are played.
Ensure the controller's and the teammate's units keep Ambush and Support.

luke-skywalker#answering-the-call.ts:
Ensure the 3 damage is dealt simultaneously to every enemy unit of every opponent, not just one chosen opponent.

luke-skywalker#answering-the-call.a2:
Ensure the 3 damage is dealt simultaneously to every unit of both enemies.
Ensure the teammate's units take no damage.
Ensure the 4-unit condition counts only units the controller controls, not the teammate's.

knobby-white-ice-spider.ts:
Ensure the number of Advantage tokens equals the total number of enemy units across all opponents.

Ensure the number of Advantage tokens equals the total number of units controlled by both enemies.
Ensure the teammate's units are not counted.

seismic-detonation.ts:
Ensure 3 damage is dealt at the start of the next regroup phase to every unit of every opponent in the chosen arena.

Ensure the teammate's units in that arena take no damage.

zam-wesell#not-what-she-seems.ts:
Ensure Zam gains the traits (except Force) of both of the controller's leaders, whether or not they are deployed, and while she is not in play.

zam-wesell#not-what-she-seems.a2:

arena-acklay#screaming-predator.ts:
Ensure 2 damage is dealt to the base of every non-eliminated opponent.
Ensure the controller's own base takes no damage.
arena-acklay#screaming-predator.a2:
Ensure 2 damage is dealt to both enemy bases.
Ensure the teammate's base takes no damage.

blockade-ship.ts:
Ensure ground units of every opponent get -1/-0 while attacking, including when they attack a player other than the controller.

Ensure ground units of both enemies get -1/-0 while attacking.

forced-pacification.ts:
Ensure the controller can exhaust the 2 units per defeated friendly unit from any mix of opponents' units.

Ensure the teammate's units can be chosen to be defeated, and each counts toward the number of enemy units exhausted.

the-inquisitors-tie#would-rather-win.ts:
Ensure each non-eliminated player, including the controller, with 4 or more cards in hand discards a card of their choice.

Ensure all four players, including the teammate, are checked individually against their own hand size and each with 4 or more cards discards a card.

k2so#evacuate-the-vault-door.ts:
Ensure 5 damage is dealt to every unit of every opponent and to every non-eliminated opponent's base.
Ensure the controller's own units and base take no damage.
k2so#evacuate-the-vault-door.a2:
Ensure 5 damage is dealt to every unit and the base of both enemies.
Ensure the teammate's units and base take no damage.

bokatan-kryze#right-place-right-time.ts:
Ensure every unit of every opponent gets -7/-0 for the phase.
Ensure the controller's own units are unaffected.
bokatan-kryze#right-place-right-time.a2:
Ensure every unit of both enemies gets -7/-0 for the phase.

director-krennic#aspiring-to-authority.ts:
Ensure only the controller's own damaged units get +1/+0; opponents' damaged units do not.

ig88#ruthless-bounty-hunter.ts:
Ensure the +1/+0 compares the controller's unit count only with the defending player's units (the attacked opponent), not other opponents'.

academy-defense-walker.ts: Ensure Experience tokens go only to the controller's own damaged units, not opponents' damaged units.
academy-defense-walker.a2: Ensure Experience tokens also go to the teammate's damaged units, and not to enemies' damaged units.

kanan-jarrus#revealed-jedi.ts: Ensure only the controller's own SPECTRE units count for the discard number, and the discard comes from the attacked opponent's deck only (not other opponents').
kanan-jarrus#revealed-jedi.a2:
Ensure the teammate's SPECTRE units count for the discard number.
Ensure the healing goes only to Kanan's controller's base, not the teammate's base.

admiral-piett#captain-of-the-executor.ts: Ensure only the controller's own non-leader units with printed cost 6 or more gain Ambush, and Ambush can attack an enemy unit of any opponent.
admiral-piett#captain-of-the-executor.a2:
Ensure the teammate's non-leader units with printed cost 6 or more also gain Ambush when the teammate plays them.
Ensure an Ambush attack can only target an enemy unit, never the teammate's or the controller's own units.

wedge-antilles#star-of-the-rebellion.ts: Ensure only the controller's own VEHICLE units get +1/+1 and Ambush, and Ambush can attack an enemy unit of any opponent.
wedge-antilles#star-of-the-rebellion.a2:
Ensure the teammate's VEHICLE units also get +1/+1 and Ambush when the teammate plays them.
Ensure an Ambush attack can only target an enemy unit, never a teammate's unit.

home-one#alliance-flagship.ts:
Ensure only the controller's own other units gain Restore 1.
Ensure the Heroism unit is played from the controller's own discard pile only.
home-one#alliance-flagship.a2:
Ensure the teammate's units also gain Restore 1.

general-krell#heartless-tactician.ts: Ensure only the controller's own other units gain the When Defeated draw, and the controller draws when each is defeated.
general-krell#heartless-tactician.a2:
Ensure the teammate's other units gain the When Defeated ability.
Ensure when a teammate's unit with the granted ability is defeated, the teammate (the unit's controller) may draw, not Krell's controller.

sabine-wren#explosives-artist.ts:
Ensure only the controller's own other units count toward the 3 aspects, and while met no opponent can attack Sabine.
Ensure Sabine's On Attack damage can target the defending unit or any base (any opponent's, or the controller's own).

Ensure the teammate's units count toward the 3 aspects, and while met neither enemy can attack Sabine.
Ensure Sabine's On Attack damage can target the defending unit or any base, including the teammate's base.

red-three#unstoppable.ts: Ensure only the controller's own other Heroism units gain Raid 1.
red-three#unstoppable.a2: Ensure the teammate's other Heroism units also gain Raid 1.

rallying-cry.ts: Ensure only the controller's own units gain Raid 2 this phase; opponents' units do not.
rallying-cry.a2: Ensure the teammate's units also gain Raid 2 this phase, and enemies' units do not.

general-veers#blizzard-force-commander.ts: Ensure only the controller's own other Imperial units get +1/+1.
general-veers#blizzard-force-commander.a2: Ensure the teammate's Imperial units also get +1/+1, and enemies' do not.

general-dodonna#massassi-group-commander.ts: Ensure only the controller's own other Rebel units get +1/+1.
general-dodonna#massassi-group-commander.a2: Ensure the teammate's Rebel units also get +1/+1, and enemies' do not.

gar-saxon#viceroy-of-mandalore.ts:
Ensure only the controller's own upgraded units get the bonus, including units with an upgrade owned by an opponent.
Ensure the deployed When Defeated returns an upgrade to its owner's hand, even when the owner is an opponent.

Ensure the teammate's upgraded units also get +1/+0 and the deployed When Defeated ability.

moff-gideon#formidable-commander.ts:
Ensure the leader action can attack only with the controller's own unit that costs 3 or less, and the +1/+0 applies when it attacks a unit of any opponent.
Ensure the deployed bonus applies only to the controller's own units that cost 3 or less.
moff-gideon#formidable-commander.a2:
Ensure the leader action cannot attack with a teammate's unit.
Ensure the deployed +1/+0 and Overwhelm also apply to the teammate's units that cost 3 or less when they attack an enemy unit.

boba-fett#daimyo.ts:
Ensure the leader side triggers only when its controller plays a keyword unit, not when an opponent plays one.
Ensure the deployed bonus applies only to the controller's own other keyword units, including units from both of their leaders' sides, and never to an opponent's.
boba-fett#daimyo.a2:
Ensure the leader side triggers only when you play a keyword unit, not when your teammate does. Ensure the +1/+0 can be given to the teammate's unit.
Ensure the deployed bonus reaches the teammate's keyword units and not the enemies'.

first-light#headquarters-of-the-crimson-.ts:
Ensure only the controller's other non-leader units gain Grit, never an opponent's.
Ensure the Smuggle cost can only deal the 4 damage to one of the controller's own units.

Ensure the teammate's non-leader units gain Grit, and enemy units do not.

finalizer#might-of-the-first-order.ts: Ensure each chosen friendly unit can capture a unit controlled by a different opponent, and only enemy non-leader units in the same arena can be captured.
finalizer#might-of-the-first-order.a2:
Ensure the chosen units can include the teammate's units, and each can capture a unit of either enemy.
Ensure the teammate's units are never legal capture targets.

the-darksaber.ts: Ensure the granted On Attack gives Experience tokens only to the attached unit's controller's other Mandalorian units, never an opponent's.
the-darksaber.a2:

Ensure that with the upgrade on a teammate's unit, the granted On Attack gives a token to each other Mandalorian unit on the team (friendly from the unit controller's view).

4lom#bounty-hunter-for-hire.ts: Ensure only the controller's own Zuckuss units get +1/+1 and Ambush, never an opponent's Zuckuss.
4lom#bounty-hunter-for-hire.a2:
Ensure the teammate's Zuckuss gets +1/+1 and Ambush, and the teammate can use that Ambush when playing it.
Ensure the Ambush attack can target an enemy unit of either enemy only.

zuckuss#bounty-hunter-for-hire.ts: Ensure only the controller's own 4-LOM units get +1/+1 and Saboteur, never an opponent's 4-LOM.
zuckuss#bounty-hunter-for-hire.a2: Ensure the teammate's 4-LOM gets +1/+1 and Saboteur, and enemy 4-LOMs do not.

tech#source-of-insight.ts: Ensure only the controller's own resources gain Smuggle, and the gained cost uses that card's printed cost plus 2 and its aspect icons.
tech#source-of-insight.a2:

Ensure the teammate plays a card with the gained Smuggle from their own resources, paying with their own resources, and you cannot spend your resources to pay for it.

nala-se#clone-engineer.ts:
Ensure the aspect penalty is ignored only on Clone units the controller plays.
Ensure, when deployed, only the controller's own Clone units gain the When Defeated heal, and it heals the controller's base.

nute-gunray#vindictive-viceroy.ts:
Ensure only the controller's own units defeated this phase count toward the 2 required, not units defeated for opponents.

nute-gunray#vindictive-viceroy.a2:

captain-rex#fighting-for-his-brothers.ts:

maul#a-rival-in-darkness.ts:

Ensure the leader action cannot attack with the teammate's unit, and the attacker can only target an enemy.

barriss-offee#unassuming-apprentice.ts: Ensure only the controller's own units healed this phase get +1/+0, not an opponent's healed units.

kraken#confederate-tactician.ts:
