admiral-yularen#advising-caution.ts: Ensure only the controller's own other Heroism units get +0/+1, never an opponent's.
admiral-yularen#advising-caution.a2: Ensure the teammate's Heroism units get +0/+1, and enemy Heroism units do not.

shaak-ti#unity-wins-wars.ts: Ensure only the controller's own token units get +1/+0; opponents' token units do not.
shaak-ti#unity-wins-wars.a2:
Ensure the teammate's token units also get +1/+0.
Ensure enemy token units do not.

pyrrhic-assault.ts:

clone-commander-cody#commanding-the-212t.ts: Ensure the 3-unit Coordinate count includes only the controller's own units (units from both leaders' sides count), and only own other units get +1/+1 and Overwhelm.

encouraging-leadership.ts: Ensure only the controller's own units get +1/+1; opponents' units do not.

low-altitude-gunship.ts:

the-invisible-hand#imposing-flagship.ts:

han-solo#never-tell-me-the-odds.ts:

Ensure that when DJ leaves play the resource returns to its owner, not to the player it was taken from if they differ.
dj#blatant-thief.a2:
Ensure the enemy resource choice spans both enemies' resources and excludes the teammate's.
Ensure the taken resource can be spent by DJ's controller only, not by the teammate.
Ensure that when DJ leaves play the resource returns to its owner.

smugglers-starfighter.ts: Ensure the debuff target choice spans every opponent's units.
smugglers-starfighter.a2:
Ensure the condition counts only another Underworld unit the controller controls; a teammate's Underworld unit does not satisfy it.
Ensure the debuff target choice spans both enemies' units and excludes the teammate's.

relentless-pursuit.ts: Ensure the capture target choice spans every opponent's non-leader units that cost the same as or less than the chosen friendly unit.
relentless-pursuit.a2:
Ensure the friendly unit choice may include the teammate's units, and a teammate's Bounty Hunter receives the Shield token.
Ensure the capture target choice spans both enemies' non-leader units and excludes the teammate's.

kragan-gorr#warbird-captain.ts:
Ensure the ability triggers when a unit controlled by any opponent attacks Kragan's controller's base, and does not trigger when it attacks another player's base.
Ensure the Shield goes to a unit of the controller in the attacker's arena, not another player's unit.
kragan-gorr#warbird-captain.a2:
Ensure the ability triggers when either enemy attacks Kragan's controller's base, and does not trigger when an enemy attacks the teammate's base.
Ensure the Shield may be given to a teammate's unit in the attacker's arena.

tarfful#kashyyyk-chieftain.ts: Ensure the ability triggers only for the controller's own Wookiee units, and the damage-dealt target choice spans every opponent's ground units.
tarfful#kashyyyk-chieftain.a2:
Ensure the ability triggers when the teammate's Wookiee unit is dealt combat damage and survives, and the damage is dealt by that Wookiee to a ground unit of either enemy (never the teammate's).
Ensure Tarfful's controller makes the target choice.

yoda#sensing-darkness.ts:
Ensure the leader side condition is met if a unit controlled by any player left play this phase.
Ensure the deployed defeat choice spans every opponent's non-leader units.
Ensure a unit removed from play by an elimination counts as having left play this phase.
yoda#sensing-darkness.a2:
Ensure the leader side condition is met if any unit left play this phase, including the teammate's and an enemy's.
Ensure the deployed defeat choice spans both enemies' non-leader units and excludes the teammate's.

jango-fett#concealing-the-conspiracy.ts: Ensure both sides trigger only when a unit the controller controls deals damage to a unit controlled by any opponent, and the exhaust applies to that enemy unit.
jango-fett#concealing-the-conspiracy.a2:
Ensure both sides trigger when the teammate's unit deals damage to an enemy unit (either enemy), and that damage to the teammate's units never triggers it.
Ensure the Jango controller makes the may-exhaust decision.

quinlan-vos#sticking-the-landing.ts:
Ensure the damaged unit can be chosen from any opponent's units whose printed cost matches (leader side: same cost; deployed: same or less).
Ensure only units you play trigger it, and only your own plays.
quinlan-vos#sticking-the-landing.a2:
Ensure the target can be a unit of either enemy player, never the teammate's unit.
Ensure a unit played by the teammate does not trigger the ability.

devastating-gunship.ts: Ensure the defeat target can be chosen from any opponent's units with 2 or less remaining HP.
devastating-gunship.a2: Ensure the defeat target can be a unit of either enemy player, and the teammate's units are not legal targets.

providence-destroyer.ts: Ensure the -2/-2 target can be chosen from any opponent's space units.
providence-destroyer.a2:
Ensure the -2/-2 target can be an enemy space unit of either enemy player, never the teammate's.
Ensure Exploit can only defeat units you control, not the teammate's.

malevolence#grievouss-secret-weapon.ts: Ensure the -4/-0 and "can't attack" target can be chosen from any opponent's units, and both effects apply to the same unit.
malevolence#grievouss-secret-weapon.a2:
Ensure the target can be a unit of either enemy player, never the teammate's.
Ensure Exploit can only defeat units you control, not the teammate's.

a-fine-addition.ts:
Ensure the condition is true if a unit controlled by any one opponent was defeated this phase, and false if only your own units were defeated.
Ensure the upgrade can be played from your hand or from any player's discard pile, with its cost paid.
a-fine-addition.a2:
Ensure the condition is true if a unit of either enemy was defeated this phase, and false if only your own or your teammate's units were defeated.
Ensure the upgrade can be taken from your hand or any player's discard pile (including the teammate's), paying with your own resources only.

vulture-interceptor-wing.ts: Ensure the -1/-1 target can be chosen from any opponent's units.
vulture-interceptor-wing.a2: Ensure the target can be a unit of either enemy player, never the teammate's.

synchronized-strike.ts: Ensure the target can be any opponent's unit, and the damage equals only the units you control in that unit's arena.
synchronized-strike.a2:
Ensure the target can be a unit of either enemy player, never the teammate's.
Ensure the damage counts only units you control in its arena, not the teammate's.

osi-sobeck#warden-of-the-citadel.ts: Ensure the captured unit can be chosen from any opponent's non-leader ground units with printed cost equal to or less than the resources paid.
osi-sobeck#warden-of-the-citadel.a2:
Ensure the captured unit can be a ground unit of either enemy player, never the teammate's.
Ensure Exploit can only defeat units you control, and the resources paid count only your own payment.

take-captive.ts: Ensure the captured unit can be chosen from any opponent's non-leader units in the same arena as your capturing unit.
take-captive.a2:
Ensure the capturing unit can be the teammate's unit (friendly includes the teammate).
Ensure the captured unit can be a non-leader unit of either enemy player in that arena, never the teammate's.

count-dooku#fallen-jedi.ts: Ensure each damage instance can target a different opponent's unit (any opponent), all dealt simultaneously.
count-dooku#fallen-jedi.a2:
Ensure each damage target can be a unit of either enemy player, never the teammate's.
Ensure Exploit can only defeat units you control, so only your own exploited units count.

jyn-erso#stardust.ts:
Ensure the bonus applies if a unit of any one opponent was defeated this phase, and not if only your own units were.
Ensure units removed from play by an opponent's elimination are not defeated and do not enable the bonus.
jyn-erso#stardust.a2: Ensure the bonus applies if a unit of either enemy was defeated this phase, and not if only your or your teammate's units were defeated.

vanguard-droid-bomber.ts: Ensure the 2 damage requires you to control another Separatist unit, and the base can be chosen from any opponent's base (a which-base choice).
vanguard-droid-bomber.a2:
Ensure only a Separatist unit you control counts, not the teammate's.
Ensure the base can be either enemy's base, never the teammate's.

reckless-torrent.ts:
Ensure the enemy unit can be chosen from any opponent's units in the same arena as the friendly unit.
Ensure the ability is gained only while you control 3 or more units.
reckless-torrent.a2:
Ensure the friendly unit can be the teammate's unit, and the enemy unit can be either enemy's unit in the same arena.
Ensure only units you control count toward the 3 or more needed to gain the ability.

aurra-sing#crackshot-sniper.ts: Ensure it readies when any opponent's ground unit attacks your base, but not when that unit attacks another player's base or a unit.
aurra-sing#crackshot-sniper.a2: Ensure it readies when either enemy's ground unit attacks your base, but not when one attacks your teammate's base.

padme-amidala#pursuing-peace.ts: Ensure the target can be any opponent's unit, with units of every opponent offered.
padme-amidala#pursuing-peace.a2:
Ensure the target can be either enemy's unit but never the teammate's unit.
Ensure the teammate's units do not count toward the 3 units needed to gain Coordinate.

enfys-nest#champion-of-justice.ts:
Ensure the eligible units (non-leader, less power than this unit) span all opponents' units.
Ensure the returned unit goes to its owner's hand.
enfys-nest#champion-of-justice.a2:
Ensure the eligible units span both enemies' units and never include the teammate's units.
Ensure the returned unit goes to its owner's hand.

sly-moore#secretive-advisor.ts:
Ensure the token unit can be chosen from any opponent's token units.
Ensure at the start of the regroup phase the token returns to its owner (the opponent it was taken from), even if Sly Moore was defeated.
sly-moore#secretive-advisor.a2:
Ensure the token unit can be chosen from either enemy's token units and never the teammate's.
Ensure at the start of the regroup phase the token returns to its owner (the enemy it was taken from), not to the teammate.

sanctioners-shuttle.ts: Ensure the eligible units (non-leader, printed cost 3 or less) span all opponents' units.
sanctioners-shuttle.a2:
Ensure the eligible units span both enemies' units and never include the teammate's units.
Ensure the teammate's units do not count toward the 3 units needed to gain Coordinate.

tridroid-suppressor.ts: Ensure the exhaust target can be any opponent's ground unit.
tridroid-suppressor.a2:
Ensure the exhaust target can be either enemy's ground unit but never the teammate's.
Ensure Exploit can defeat only units the player controls, not the teammate's units.

in-pursuit.ts: Ensure the enemy unit to exhaust can be any opponent's unit.
in-pursuit.a2:
Ensure the friendly unit to exhaust can be the teammate's unit.
Ensure the enemy unit to exhaust can be either enemy's unit but never the teammate's.

prisoner-of-war.ts:
Ensure the captured unit can be any opponent's non-leader, non-Vehicle unit.
Ensure the Battle Droid tokens are created only if the enemy unit's printed cost is less than the friendly unit's.
prisoner-of-war.a2:
Ensure the capturing friendly unit can be the teammate's unit, and the captured unit is chosen only from the two enemies' units.
Ensure the 2 Battle Droid tokens are created under the event player's control, even when the teammate's unit captured.

asajj-ventress#i-work-alone.ts:
Ensure the enemy unit must be in the same arena as the damaged friendly unit and can belong to any opponent.
Ensure the deployed On Attack works the same way.
asajj-ventress#i-work-alone.a2: Ensure the friendly unit to damage can be the teammate's unit, and the enemy unit (same arena) can belong to either enemy.

q.t: Can Asajj deploy as a Pilot upgrade on a teammate's Vehicle, and if so does the granted On Attack (used by the teammate under the working assumption) take its 'friendly unit' from the teammate's side?

annihilator#tagges-flagship.ts:
Ensure the unit to defeat can be any opponent's unit, from both When Played and When Defeated.
Ensure the search is of the defeated unit's controller's deck and hand (the opponent who controlled it), and only that player shuffles.
annihilator#tagges-flagship.a2:
Ensure the unit to defeat can be either enemy's unit but never the teammate's.
Ensure the search is of the defeated unit's controller's deck and hand, and the teammate's deck and hand are not searched.

raddus#holdos-final-command.ts: Ensure the When Defeated damage can target any opponent's unit.
raddus#holdos-final-command.a2:
Ensure a Resistance card controlled by the teammate does not give Sentinel; only the player's own Resistance cards count.
Ensure the When Defeated damage can target either enemy's unit but never the teammate's.

lightspeed-assault.ts:
Ensure the enemy space unit can belong to any opponent, and the indirect damage goes to that unit's controller, who assigns it among their own units and base.
Ensure the indirect damage still happens if the enemy unit was defeated by the damage.
lightspeed-assault.a2:
Ensure the friendly space unit to defeat can be the teammate's unit.
Ensure the enemy space unit can belong to either enemy, and the indirect damage goes to that unit's controller only, not to the other enemy or the teammate.

ig88#murderous-phlutdroid.ts: Ensure IG-88 gets +3/+0 when a unit controlled by any one opponent is damaged, and loses it when no opponent's unit is damaged.
ig88#murderous-phlutdroid.a2:
Ensure a damaged unit of either enemy gives +3/+0, and a damaged teammate's unit does not.
Ensure the bonus is not applied twice if units of both enemies are damaged.

fight-fire-with-fire.ts:
Ensure the enemy unit can belong to any opponent and must be in the same arena as the chosen friendly unit.
Ensure no damage is dealt if no friendly and enemy unit share an arena.
fight-fire-with-fire.a2:
Ensure the friendly unit can be the teammate's unit, and the enemy unit (same arena) can belong to either enemy.
Ensure no damage is dealt if no friendly (own or teammate's) and enemy unit share an arena.

face-off.ts:
Ensure the ability does nothing if any player (any opponent) has taken the initiative this phase.
Ensure the enemy unit to ready can belong to any opponent.
face-off.a2:
Ensure the ability does nothing if the initiative has been taken this phase by the teammate or by either enemy.
Ensure the enemy unit can belong to either enemy, and the friendly unit to ready (same arena) can be the teammate's unit.

cat-and-mouse.ts:
Ensure the exhaust target can be a unit of any opponent.
Ensure the friendly unit readied must be in the same arena and have power equal to or less than the exhausted enemy unit, whichever opponent controls it.
cat-and-mouse.a2:
Ensure the exhaust target can be a unit of either enemy player, and never the teammate's unit.
Ensure the readied unit can be the teammate's unit (friendly) if it is in the same arena with power equal to or less than the exhausted enemy unit.

sidon-ithano#the-crimson-corsair.ts: Ensure the Vehicle choice spans every opponent's Vehicle units without a Pilot, and Sidon attaches to the chosen one regardless of which opponent controls it.
sidon-ithano#the-crimson-corsair.a2:
Ensure the Vehicle choice includes Vehicles of either enemy player.
Ensure the teammate's Vehicle is not a legal target.

temple-of-destruction.ts:
Ensure it triggers when a friendly unit deals 3 or more combat damage to any opponent's base, not only a particular opponent's.
Ensure the Force token goes to the Temple's controller.
temple-of-destruction.a2:
Ensure it triggers when the teammate's unit deals 3 or more combat damage to either enemy base, and the Force token is created for the Temple's controller.
Ensure it does not trigger for damage to the teammate's base.

darth-vader#twilight-of-the-apprentice.ts:
Ensure the When Played enemy unit choice spans all opponents' units.
Ensure the On Attack defeat can choose any opponent's unit with a Shield token, not only units of the attacked player.
darth-vader#twilight-of-the-apprentice.a2:
Ensure the When Played Shield can be given to the teammate's unit as the friendly unit, and the enemy unit can belong to either enemy player.
Ensure the On Attack defeat can choose a shielded unit of either enemy, and never a shielded teammate unit.

craving-power.ts: Ensure the damage target can be a unit of any opponent.
craving-power.a2:
Ensure it can be attached to the teammate's unit (friendly), and the damage equals that attached unit's power.
Ensure the damage target can be a unit of either enemy, never the teammate's.

protect-the-pod.ts: Ensure the damaged enemy unit can belong to any opponent.
protect-the-pod.a2:
Ensure the friendly non-Vehicle unit can be the teammate's unit, dealing damage equal to its remaining HP.
Ensure the damaged unit can belong to either enemy and never the teammate.

hk47#exclamation-die-meatbag.ts:
Ensure it triggers for an enemy unit defeated by any opponent's loss, and the 1 damage goes to the base of that unit's controller.
Ensure units of different opponents defeated simultaneously each cause 1 damage to their own controller's base.
hk47#exclamation-die-meatbag.a2:
Ensure it triggers for units of either enemy and damages the base of the defeated unit's controller.
Ensure the teammate's unit being defeated does not trigger it.

quinlan-vos#dark-disciple.ts: Ensure the optional 2 damage requires choosing which enemy base, and any opponent's base is legal, not only the attacked one.
quinlan-vos#dark-disciple.a2:
Ensure the 2 damage can target either enemy base.
Ensure the teammate's base is not a legal target.

life-wind-sage.ts: Ensure Raid 2 is active while a unit of any one opponent is exhausted, and ends when none are.
life-wind-sage.a2:
Ensure Raid 2 is active while a unit of either enemy is exhausted.
Ensure an exhausted teammate unit does not grant Raid 2.

impossible-escape.ts: Ensure the enemy unit to exhaust can belong to any opponent.
impossible-escape.a2:
Ensure exhausting the teammate's unit counts as exhausting a friendly unit and enables the exhaust and draw.
Ensure the exhaust target can be a unit of either enemy, never the teammate's.

a-precarious-predicament.ts:
Ensure the unit choice spans all opponents' non-leader units, and only the chosen unit's controller decides whether to say "It could be worse."
Ensure the other opponents get no say.
a-precarious-predicament.a2:
Ensure only the controller of the chosen unit (an enemy) decides whether to say "It could be worse"; the enemy's teammate gets no say.
Ensure the teammate's units are not legal targets.

ill-cover-for-you.ts: Ensure the two different enemy units can belong to the same opponent or to two different opponents.
ill-cover-for-you.a2:
Ensure the two different enemy units can belong to the same enemy or to both enemies.
Ensure the teammate's units are not legal targets.

r2d2#known-to-make-mistakes.ts: Ensure the exhaust target can be an enemy ground unit costing 4 or less of any opponent.
r2d2#known-to-make-mistakes.a2:
Ensure the teammate's Command unit does not satisfy "if you control a Command unit."
Ensure the exhaust target can be an eligible ground unit of either enemy, never the teammate's.

go-for-the-legs.ts: Ensure the ground unit choice spans every opponent's ground units.
go-for-the-legs.a2: Ensure the target can be a ground unit of either enemy and never the teammate's.

jabba-the-hutt#wonderful-human-being.ts:
Ensure the leader-side action can target an enemy unit controlled by any opponent.
Ensure the deployed trigger fires for each friendly unit that survives damage dealt by any source, and its once-per-round limit applies to the controller regardless of which opponent's damage triggered it.
Ensure the unit it deals damage to can belong to any opponent.
jabba-the-hutt#wonderful-human-being.a2:
Ensure the leader-side action's damaged friendly unit may be the teammate's unit, and the damage target can be either enemy's unit but never the teammate's.
Ensure the deployed trigger fires when the teammate's unit (friendly) survives damage, the damage goes to either enemy's unit, and the once-per-round limit is Jabba's controller's own.

cantwell-arrestor-cruiser.ts:
Ensure the exhausted unit can belong to any opponent.
Ensure the unit still can't ready after another player takes control of Cantwell, until Cantwell leaves play.
cantwell-arrestor-cruiser.a2:
Ensure the exhausted unit can belong to either enemy but not the teammate.
Ensure only the controller's own hand and aspects can satisfy the disclose, not the teammate's.

populist-advisor.ts:
Ensure combat damage to the controller's base from a unit of any opponent triggers the ability.
Ensure damage to another player's base does not trigger it.
populist-advisor.a2:
Ensure combat damage to the controller's own base from either enemy's unit triggers it.
Ensure combat damage to the teammate's base does not trigger it.

cassian-andor#lay-low.ts:
Ensure damage from an ability controlled by any opponent is reduced by 2, and combat damage is not.
Ensure the attacker gets -2/-0 when any opponent's unit attacks him.
cassian-andor#lay-low.a2:
Ensure damage from an ability controlled by either enemy is reduced by 2.
Ensure damage from an ability controlled by the teammate is not prevented (not an enemy card ability).

captain-rex#into-the-firefight.ts:
Ensure the enemy unit given Sentinel can belong to any opponent.
Ensure that Sentinel protects only its own controller's units and base.
captain-rex#into-the-firefight.a2:
Ensure the enemy unit given Sentinel can belong to either enemy but not the teammate.
Ensure the granted Sentinel protects only that enemy unit's controller and their teammate, not Rex's team.

lando-calrissian#trust-me.ts:
Ensure the enemy unit can belong to any opponent, and the captured friendly unit goes under that enemy unit.
Ensure the heal 6 applies to Lando's controller's own base.
lando-calrissian#trust-me.a2:
Ensure the enemy unit can belong to either enemy, and the other friendly non-leader unit may be the teammate's unit.
Ensure the heal 6 applies to Lando's controller's own base, not the teammate's.

charged-with-corruption.ts: Ensure the captured non-leader unit can belong to any opponent.
charged-with-corruption.a2:
Ensure the disclose uses only the controller's own hand and aspects.
Ensure the capturing friendly unit may be the teammate's unit, and the captured unit can belong to either enemy but never the teammate.

hunting-assassin-droid.ts: Ensure Raid 2 is active while a damaged unit controlled by any one opponent exists.
hunting-assassin-droid.a2:
Ensure Raid 2 is active while a damaged unit of either enemy exists.
Ensure a damaged teammate unit does not activate it.

grand-moff-tarkin#taking-krennics-achiev.ts:
Ensure the Vehicle taken can belong to any opponent.
Ensure when Tarkin leaves play, the unit returns to its owner's control, not to the previous controller if they differ.
grand-moff-tarkin#taking-krennics-achiev.a2:
Ensure the Vehicle taken can belong to either enemy but not the teammate.
Ensure when Tarkin leaves play, the unit returns to its owner's control.

arrest.ts:
Ensure the captured unit can belong to any opponent, and is captured by the controller's base.
Ensure at the start of the regroup phase its owner rescues it, whoever controlled it.
arrest.a2:
Ensure the controller's own base (not the teammate's) captures a unit of either enemy, never the teammate.
Ensure at the start of regroup its owner rescues it.

the-mandalorian#cleaning-up-nevarro.ts: Ensure the unit captured can belong to any opponent, not only the defender's controller.
the-mandalorian#cleaning-up-nevarro.a2:
Ensure the unit captured can belong to either enemy, not only the defender's controller.
Ensure the teammate's units are never legal capture targets.

libertine#under-new-ownership.ts: Ensure the enemy unit can belong to any opponent, and it captures the chosen friendly non-leader unit.
libertine#under-new-ownership.a2:
Ensure the enemy unit can belong to either enemy, and the chosen friendly non-leader unit may be the teammate's unit.
Ensure only cards Libertine itself guards add power.

unruly-astromech.ts:
Ensure the exhausted unit can belong to any opponent.
Ensure no opponent can attack it the phase it was played.
unruly-astromech.a2:
Ensure the exhausted unit can belong to either enemy but not the teammate.
Ensure neither enemy can attack it the phase it was played.

covert-operative.ts: Ensure the captured unit can belong to any opponent; only printed cost 2 or less is legal.
covert-operative.a2: Ensure the captured unit can belong to either enemy, never the teammate; only printed cost 2 or less is legal.

heroic-arc170.ts:
Ensure the damaged-unit condition counts only units you control (a damaged unit controlled by an opponent does not enable it).
Ensure the 2 damage can target a unit controlled by any opponent.
heroic-arc170.a2:
Ensure a damaged unit controlled by your teammate does not satisfy the condition ("you control" counts only your own cards).
Ensure the 2 damage can target a unit of either enemy player but never the teammate's units.

moral-authority.ts:
Ensure the captured unit can be chosen from the non-leader units of any opponent with less remaining HP than the attached unit.
Ensure the choice includes every opponent's qualifying units, not only one opponent's.
moral-authority.a2:
Ensure the upgrade can be attached to a unique unit controlled by the teammate, and that unit captures the enemy unit (it is held by the teammate's unit).
Ensure the captured unit can come from either enemy player but never from the teammate.

director-krennic#amidst-my-achievement.ts:
Ensure the deployed ability's damage can target a unit controlled by any opponent.
Ensure the leader-side Credit token is created for Krennic's controller only.
director-krennic#amidst-my-achievement.a2:
Ensure a teammate's unit can be defeated as the leader-side cost and can be chosen as the "another friendly unit" that deals the damage.
Ensure the damage target can be a unit of either enemy player but never the teammate's units.

the-client#please-lower-your-blaster.ts:
Ensure the exhaust target can be a unit controlled by any opponent.
Ensure only tokens you created this phase satisfy the condition (a token created by an opponent does not).
the-client#please-lower-your-blaster.a2:
Ensure a token created by your teammate this phase does not satisfy the condition ("you created" is personal).
Ensure the exhaust target can be a unit of either enemy player but never the teammate's units.

latts-razzi#deadly-whipmaster.ts: Ensure the damage can target a ground unit controlled by any opponent.
latts-razzi#deadly-whipmaster.a2: Ensure the damage can target a ground unit of either enemy player but never the teammate's ground units.

benthic-two-tubes#the-war-has-just-begun.ts:
Ensure the On Attack damage can target a ground unit controlled by any opponent.
Ensure the When Defeated damage can target any base, including your own and every opponent's base (a which-base choice), since the text says "a base" not "an enemy base".
benthic-two-tubes#the-war-has-just-begun.a2:
Ensure the On Attack damage can target a ground unit of either enemy player but never the teammate's.
Ensure the When Defeated damage can target your own base, your teammate's base, or either enemy base.

interrogation-droid.ts:
Ensure the exhaust target can be a unit controlled by any opponent.
Ensure that only the exhausted unit's controller discards (the other opponents do not), and a unit costing more than 3 printed cost causes no discard.
interrogation-droid.a2:
Ensure the exhaust target can be a unit of either enemy player but never the teammate's.
Ensure only the exhausted unit's controller discards; the other enemy and the teammate do not.

jango-fett#wily-mercenary.ts:
Ensure that when Jango is upgraded, the exhaust target can be a unit controlled by any opponent.
Ensure the condition is met by any upgrade attached to Jango, including one played by an opponent.
jango-fett#wily-mercenary.a2:
Ensure the exhaust target can be a unit of either enemy player but never the teammate's.
Ensure an upgrade attached to Jango by your teammate satisfies "this unit is upgraded".

val#its-been-a-ride-babe.ts: Ensure the When Defeated Shield can be given to a unit controlled by any opponent, chosen by Val's controller.
val#its-been-a-ride-babe.a2:
Ensure the When Played Shield can be given to a teammate's unit as the "another friendly unit".
Ensure the When Defeated Shield can be given to a unit of either enemy player but never the teammate's.

display-piece.ts:
Ensure the defeated unit can be a non-leader unit controlled by any opponent.
Ensure the unit's controller (not necessarily its owner) resources it from its owner's discard pile, and no other player gains a resource.
display-piece.a2:
Ensure the defeated unit can be a non-leader unit of either enemy player but never the teammate's.
Ensure the unit's controller resources it from its owner's discard pile, and the other enemy and the teammate do not gain a resource.

defiant-scrapper.ts: Ensure the Credit token to defeat can be chosen from the Credit tokens of any opponent, and your own Credit tokens are not legal targets.
defiant-scrapper.a2: Ensure the Credit token can be chosen from either enemy player's tokens, and neither your own nor your teammate's Credit tokens are legal targets.

the-tree-remembers.ts: Ensure the target can be a unit controlled by any opponent, and the defeat applies only if its printed cost is 3 or less.
the-tree-remembers.a2: Ensure the target can be a unit of either enemy player but never the teammate's.

the-sarlacc-of-carkoon#horror-of-the-dun.ts:
